signups: New accounts created on each day of the window.
gainLoss: New accounts against lost accounts on each day. Lost counts accounts where the bot was switched off, access was revoked, the account was deleted or the user was banned from chat.
funnel: Signups, finished setups and bot enables in the window. Each step counts events in the window, so later steps can include earlier signups.
churn: Bot disabled, access revoked, accounts deleted and chat bans, summed over the window.
presets: Setup presets picked during onboarding, summed over the window.
active: Channels the bot served on each day of the window.
live: Channels that went live on each day of the window.
messages: Chat messages the bot read on each day of the window.
answered: Commands the bot answered on each day of the window.
activity: Totals over the window, plus channels live in the last full week.
cohorts: Share of each signup week's accounts that the bot served in each later week. Darker means more.
plans: Accounts by plan in the latest daily snapshot, how many of each have the bot enabled, and paid plans waiting to cancel or on a failed payment.
sources: Paid accounts by how the plan was granted, in the latest daily snapshot.
billing: Billing events summed over the window.
conversion: For each of the last 12 signup weeks, accounts in the latest daily snapshot and how many are paid.
modules: Per module: channels with it on in the latest daily snapshot, channels using it in the last full week, outputs and toggles over the window.
breadth: Channels grouped by how many modules they have on, in the latest daily snapshot.
integrations: Channels with each integration connected, in the latest daily snapshot.
pagesHidden: Accounts that hide each public page, in the latest daily snapshot.
builtIn: Top 30 built-in commands by uses over the window, with uses and channels in the last full week.
custom: Custom commands created, deleted and used over the window, and the latest daily snapshot of their totals.
perms: Custom commands by who may run them, in the latest daily snapshot.
flags: Custom commands by option, in the latest daily snapshot.
locales: Accounts by interface language, in the latest daily snapshot.
